SELECT B.TRAD_TYPE AS Code ,C.TRAD_NAME AS Name,C.IT_TYPE As ItType,C.AVG_FINE As ClFine,C.AVG_TOUCH,C.AVG_AMT,C.CLG_AC,C.CLOSING_AC,C.TRAD_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.ITM_MRP <> 0 THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE -A.ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClPcs, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.TRAD_TYPE <> ''

SELECT A.TRAD_TYPE AS Code,A.IT_TYPE As ItType,B.TRAD_NAME AS Name,B.AVG_RATE As ClRate,B.AVG_NWT AS ClNwt,B.TOT_PCS AS ClPcs,B.PCS_RATE,B.CLG_AC,B.CLOSING_AC,B.AVG_AMT,0 As ClFine,B.TRAD_AMT FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN BAL_GR AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.TRAD_TYPE = B.TRAD_TYPE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? Select B.AC_GR,A.AC_CODE,ROUND(SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT),2) AS BalAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' ? T ? P ? AND B.AC_MAIN_GR >= '3' ? AND B.AC_MAIN_GR < '3' ? and VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY B.AC_GR,A.AC_CODE HAVING ROUND(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT),2) <> 0 ORDER BY A.AC_CODE

Select B.AC_GR,A.AC_CODE,A.DATA_TYPE,ROUND(SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT),2) AS BalAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? Select B.AC_GR,A.AC_CODE,A.DATA_TYPE,ROUND(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT),2) AS BalAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ?
